title: Chronodynamics
description: If time is quantised, its quanta can be stored.

puzzle.goal: An observable A may depend explicitly on time, and the state evolves under the Hamiltonian H. Write the rate of change of the expectation value ⟨A⟩: one part comes from how A fails to commute with the energy, the other from A's own explicit time dependence.
puzzle.name: Heisenberg equation of motion for expectation values (Ehrenfest form)
puzzle.form: i / ħ * avg ( comm ( H , A ) ) + avg ( pd ( A , t ) )
puzzle.ask: Combining this with the uncertainty relation ΔA·ΔE ≥ ½|⟨[A,H]⟩| gives ΔE·τ ≥ ħ/2, where τ = ΔA / |d⟨A⟩/dt| is the time for A to change noticeably. Find the minimum energy spread (eV) of a state that changes in τ = Δt = @{Δt} fs, with ħ = 0.658 eV fs.
puzzle.method: Differentiate ⟨ψ|A|ψ⟩ with the product rule and use iħ ∂|ψ⟩/∂t = H|ψ⟩ for the state and its adjoint.
